title: Fail-closed object-density increase in RL fuzzer
reproduced_defect: RL fuzzer _perturb_object_density silently ignored object_density_scale > 1.0. sample_action() samples up to 1.2, but _perturb_object_density capped keep_count at min(len(pairs), keep_count), so scale > 1.0 kept all objects and produced no evidence that the requested increase was unrealizable. Verified: scale 1.5 on 5 objects returned 5 objects (no increase, no status).

existing_pr_overlap.PR_49: fixes cubic lane-width scaling (a,b,c,d) ONLY; does NOT touch _perturb_object_density. Object-density code identical between production and PR #49 branch (dc86a409). Not in production (merge base 65eb0f14, behind 502dda26).
existing_pr_overlap.PR_65: does not exist as a separate PR. Camera intrinsic work (d57271da) not in production either.
existing_pr_overlap.OC_01: ea2d3ac8 - camera intrinsic realization, extrinsic-agnostic, no overlap with OC-05-F1

source_correction.change: _perturb_object_density now returns density_status=UNSUPPORTED_DENSITY_INCREASE when scale > 1.0, preserves all objects, records requested_scale and reason. Scale <= 1.0 preserves existing subsampling behavior. validate_action rejects nonfinite density values (NaN/Inf).
source_correction.rationale: Frozen RQ4 protocol does not authorize adding synthetic objects. No object-generation policy invented. Impossible density requests explicitly rejected rather than silently faked.

negative_controls: scale > 1.0 returns UNSUPPORTED_DENSITY_INCREASE and does not modify input map (byte-identical)
scale == 1.0 preserves all objects with density_status=UNCHANGED
scale < 1.0 subsamples deterministically under fixed seed (same kept IDs)
PR #49 cubic lane-width scaling preserved (a,b,c,d all scaled uniformly)
input map never mutated for any scale factor
